scenario: You are working at a science museum. Your manager is training you to assist visitors at the space exhibit. Listen to the manager and repeat what the manager says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Your station today is the space exhibit.
Children love pressing the buttons on the rocket display.
Make sure that no one climbs on the model of the moon.
If a visitor asks a question you can't answer, call a supervisor.
The planetarium show starts every hour, and the seats fill up very fast.
When the museum is crowded, guide people toward the quieter rooms on the second floor.
